sections.heading: 属的建立与组成
sections.heading_en: Establishment and composition of the genus

paragraphs.text: 据摘要，Cancello 与 Noirot（2003）建立近凸白蚁属（Paraconvexitermes），隶于白蚁科（Termitidae）象白蚁亚科（Nasutitermitinae），含新种圆头近凸白蚁（Paraconvexitermes acangapua），以及由凸白蚁属（Convexitermes）移入的黑角近凸白蚁（Paraconvexitermes nigricornis）与细长近凸白蚁（Paraconvexitermes junceus）。
paragraphs.text_en: According to the abstract, Cancello and Noirot (2003) erected Paraconvexitermes in Termitidae: Nasutitermitinae, containing the new species Paraconvexitermes acangapua together with Paraconvexitermes nigricornis and Paraconvexitermes junceus, both transferred from Convexitermes.
paragraphs.text_es: Según el resumen, Cancello y Noirot (2003) erigieron Paraconvexitermes en Termitidae: Nasutitermitinae, con la especie nueva Paraconvexitermes acangapua junto con Paraconvexitermes nigricornis y Paraconvexitermes junceus, ambas transferidas desde Convexitermes.

paragraphs.text: 凸白蚁属（Convexitermes）经此调整后仅余曼凸白蚁（Convexitermes manni）与凸额凸白蚁（Convexitermes convexifrons）2 种。
paragraphs.text_en: After this rearrangement Convexitermes retains only two species, Convexitermes manni and Convexitermes convexifrons.
paragraphs.text_es: Tras este reajuste, Convexitermes conserva solo dos especies, Convexitermes manni y Convexitermes convexifrons.

paragraphs.text: 该研究比较了近凸白蚁属（Paraconvexitermes）、凸白蚁属（Convexitermes）与阿特拉斯白蚁属（Atlantitermes）工蚁的消化道，据此界定这 3 个属，并提供工蚁消化道与上颚、兵蚁头部、有翅成虫头部与次生繁殖雌蚁的图。
paragraphs.text_en: The study compared the worker digestive tract of Paraconvexitermes, Convexitermes and Atlantitermes as a basis for delimiting the three genera, and illustrated the worker gut and mandibles, the soldier head, the alate head and the secondary reproductive female.
paragraphs.text_es: El estudio comparó el tubo digestivo de los obreros de Paraconvexitermes, Convexitermes y Atlantitermes como base para delimitar los tres géneros, e ilustró el intestino y las mandíbulas del obrero, la cabeza del soldado, la cabeza del imago y la hembra reproductora secundaria.

references.citation: Cancello E. M.; Noirot C. 2003. Paraconvexitermes acangapua(Isoptera: Termitidae, Nasutitermitinae), a new genus and new species of the so-called “small Neotropical soil-feeding nasutes” from South America.
